title: UFC Fighter Neutralizes a Threat with His Byrna
summary: Learn how a UFC fighter used his Byrna launcher to respond to a real-world threat. Discover how less-lethal self-defense tools can provide added confidence and protection.
body_markdown:
## How to Respond to an Intruder: Using the Right Force Option for the Situation


Defending a home is about being prepared for different situations and[having options that allow for an appropriate response.](https://byrna.com/collections/byrna-non-lethal-guns) Not every encounter requires the same approach, which is why maintaining awareness, creating distance, and understanding available force options can be important parts of a home defense plan.


### Creating Distance During a Home Defense Situation


In this scenario, Cory discovers a person rummaging through his trash. Although the individual has not yet demonstrated an intent to physically harm anyone, the person is trespassing and refuses to leave.


Rather than immediately approaching the individual, Cory maintains a reactionary gap of more than 60 feet. He also gives multiple clear verbal commands instructing the individual to leave.


Maintaining distance provides additional time to assess what is happening and determine an appropriate response if the situation changes.


### Using Byrna MAX for Area Denial


When the individual continues to refuse commands, Cory uses Byrna MAX rounds against the trash can rather than directly targeting the person. The chemical projectiles create a cloud in the surrounding area, exposing the intruder to the chemical agent while maintaining distance.


This approach demonstrates how different force options can be incorporated into a broader home defense strategy. Depending on how the situation develops, maintaining distance and using an indirect chemical response can leave additional options available, including retreating into the home or escalating to a direct response if necessary.


### Preparedness Means Having Options


A home defense plan should account for more than one possible scenario. An unwanted visitor, a trespasser, or an active threat can each require a different response.


By maintaining a safe distance, using verbal commands, and understanding how different less-lethal options work, homeowners can be better prepared to respond appropriately as circumstances change.


The goal of preparedness is not simply having a tool available. It is understanding how to use available options responsibly while maintaining awareness, distance, and a clear plan for getting to safety.
